prompt: This watercolor illustration portrays a cozy bicycle repair shop filled with vibrant colors and fluid brushstrokes. In the center, a mechanic with greasy hands tightens a bolt on a teal mountain bike mounted on a repair stand. To the left, a customer in a yellow raincoat points at a broken chain lying on the counter, while a shop assistant in a blue apron listens attentively. A basket of colorful helmets hangs on the wall behind them, next to a rack of spare tires. On the right, a child in a red jacket pushes a small pink bicycle toward the exit, accompanied by a parent carrying a helmet. A black cat sleeps on a stack of magazines in the foreground, near a coffee mug and a toolkit. Sunlight streams through the front window, illuminating dust motes dancing in the air. The interactions include tightening, pointing, listening, pushing, carrying, and sleeping, bringing life to the static scene. Shelves in the background are stocked with boxes of parts and lubricants, painted in loose, expressive washes. The floor is tiled in checkered black and white, reflecting the ambient light. The overall composition balances the mechanical elements with human activity, using the translucent quality of watercolor to soften the industrial edges of the workshop environment.
